public_format.structure: At the content_check.path, supply {sections:[{section_id,body,claims:[claim]}]}. Preserve unrelated existing sections. Every section_id must be a unique nonempty string. Each contracted section has exactly one claim. Contracted section/claim identifiers are those in content_check.claims.
public_format.claim_values: Use actual adopted source value/period. source_alias and source_path identify that claim's public source/value_path. status is supported for a numeric value, unresolved for null; null stays JSON null.
public_format.trend: If current value is null, unknown. If no previous_path is declared, unassessed. Otherwise unknown if previous is null, up/down/flat from comparison to the previous value.
public_format.body_placeholders: Use the public claim label and actual values; null renders as the literal unknown. The contracted body is exactly one of these two full finite sentences. Free prose belongs in uncontracted sections and is not semantically graded.
public_format.source_references: At each content_check.sources.reference_path, include object_id and version_id matching this exact work's actual source adoption. Source fields in JSON do not create adoption facts.

contract.facts: Readable original start/end state and independent byte copies of all committed versions, original experience prefix and exact [start,end) interval, world/instance/branch, source/scenario/policy identities, responsibility, fixed submissions/files and termination facts.
contract.responsibility: Exact work IDs or predeclared work nodes. Node selection uses end-state maintenance_heads followed through real replacements; accepted predecessors are retained separately, not counted as extra active targets.
contract.historical: Only snapshot Store data and captured exact bytes. Live world location is not queried; current progress is a separate entry. Independent goals cannot switch to future S2.
contract.integrity: Snapshot/experience digest mismatch or missing evidence becomes source_unavailable, not a worker arithmetic failure. Unforeseen implementation fault remains evaluator_error.
contract.does_not_claim: No adversarial host/Python sandbox, arbitrary instruction-point recovery, provider weight immutability or universal goal attribution.
